column3: Header on the bracket line erased for the if and closure cases; the for header moved to its own line.
Multi-line if suite closed by a paren on its last line joined; the match case remains.
Closure bodies ending at a comma line or a closing paren line joined; only a formatter-added comma line remains.
Glued x-=1 spaced to x -= 1, so the glued longest-match case is gone.
Copy marker in a same-line suite became a multi-line suite; the field-label and assignment forms remain.
Multi-line parameter list joined; parenthesized multi-line closure bodies became same-line; single-line closures remain.
Closure body in the if header is now same-line, so no nested suite inside the header remains.
The negative-literal line after else joined to one line; the match arm and headers remain.
Same-line fn bodies one_line and test became indented; same-line if remains.
Leading .len and .slice lines under a head or match arm joined; one deeper .slice line remains.
Same-line let-else body became an indented body; the indented form remains.
Line break after the opening paren before the closure joined; the nesting remains.
Nested suite inside run( joined to one line; the deeper-body form is gone.
Else on its own line after a same-line if joined onto the if line.
Bracketed expression collapsed to one line; no line starts with a dot or operator.
Same-line for suites and same-line bodies became indented; no same-line for remains.
Same-line for and while suites with else became indented blocks; no same-line loop else remains.
Both same-line if suites holding a let list became indented; no same-line let-list suite remains.
Trailing comma in the grouped use with an alias removed; the title names that form.
All three grouped-use trailing commas removed.
Leading BOM bytes stripped.
Glued left!=right spaced to left != right; the != one-token case is gone, bang calls remain.
Same-line if body became indented, so the .Variant line no longer follows a same-line if.
Every list whose lines open with a bracket or bang collapsed to one line.
Current file has zero CR bytes; the CRLF line endings the title requires are gone.
Multi-line if inside a list ending in an indented suite joined; the match inside parens remains.
Call, nested-list, map and index-bracket continuations joined; the struct literal and roles list remain.
Comment lines at off-block indentation re-indented; nested if and else flattened to one line.
Most leading-dot method-chain lines joined; one .double() after a comment line remains.
Deeper leading .grow() and .size lines joined onto the step name; no leading-dot continuation remains.
Most leading-dot and match-arm continuations joined; .double() and .read() after blank and comment lines remain.
The := chain with a leading .size line is now one line; no such chain remains.
Pipe lines after a raw head or a leading .len joined; pipes after comment and blank lines remain.
Same-line if ... let ... else forms became indented; no same-line if with let remains.
Parenthesized (time.s) became time.s; the parenthesized function value is gone.
A final line ending was added; the file no longer ends without one.
Glued operators such as f!=g, shifted<<=1, a-=b and m*=2 spaced out throughout.
Glued operators in statements such as x:=-b, y=-b and z%=3 spaced; glued ones in interpolations remain.
Every same-line suite became indented, including the else-if continuation, loop, let and parenthesized-if bodies.
Same-line for and while suites, including one before else, became indented blocks.
Right-side if and closure suites joined to one line; right-side match suites remain.
Most trailing commas removed; those in an interpolated call and a closure header remain.
Parens removed from (1 + 2) = 3; a binary left side is a syntax error, not invalid-assignment-target.
The only same-line suite binding was indented, so the same-line case the title names is gone.
